title: The optimal van der Corput property for squares
summary: We prove a sharp quantitative form of the van der Corput property for squares. For all sufficiently large $N$, we construct a real trigonometric polynomial $P(θ)=a_0+\sum_{1\le n\le\sqrt N}a_n\cos(2πn^2θ)$ satisfying \begin{equation}\tag{1}\label{eq:abstract-vdc} P(θ)\ge0\quad(θ\in\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}),\qquad P(0)=1, \end{equation} with \[0\le a_0\le\exp(-c\sqrt{\log N\log\log N}),\] where $c>0$ is an absolute constant.
